verdict.rationale: Solid documents that it is web-component friendly and can author custom elements (solid-gh-7). Its minimal abstractions give direct DOM access (solid-gh-8). Together these plausibly let interactive components be dropped into an existing page, but nothing in the evidence explicitly describes mounting into a server-rendered page that Solid did not produce. Its progressive hydration (solid-gh-4) applies to Solid's own SSR output, not arbitrary existing HTML. Missing for 10: explicit docs on mounting components into existing server-rendered pages (islands/progressive enhancement), guidance on incremental adoption without a build pipeline, hands-on corroboration of embedding into legacy pages.
